title: {session}.json (session manifest)
description: Created by step 2 (create-session.sh). cc_session_id is the Claude Code session id captured at step 2 (entry-flow). pid is the OS process id of the live claude main process (resolved by find-claude-pid.sh - walks up the process tree until comm basename == claude). worktree_path / branch / base_branch are populated unconditionally - every session lives in its own worktree post-Phase-4. bump_hint is populated by step 12 as an in-manifest record only; the project-side deploy skill (which owns the VERSION bump) derives the tier from commit-type buckets, and these manifests are removed with their worktrees at /apex-merge cleanup before deploy runs. See apex-core.md Conventions / Session manifest schema.

pid.description: OS pid of the live claude main process owning the session. Resolved at create-session.sh time via find-claude-pid.sh. NEVER set to a transient subshell pid - the worktree-resident manifest must stay valid for the lifetime of the apex run.

cc_session_id.description: Claude Code session id captured at step 2; never overwritten

worktree_path.description: Absolute path to this session's git worktree under <repo>/.apex-worktrees/<session>/. cleanup-session.sh reads this to fork the worktree-remove branch; /apex-merge enumerates worktrees via this path.

branch.description: apex/<session> branch name created at step 2.

base_branch.description: The branch HEAD was on when step 2 created the worktree. /apex-merge step 4 merges apex/<session> back onto this branch.

bump_hint.description: VERSION bump tier classified by step 12, retained as an in-manifest record only. NOT consumed by the project-side deploy skill (e.g. .claude/skills/deploy/ in the project repo): deploy derives the tier from the merged commits' types (commit-type buckets), picks the highest across the batch, and runs bump-version.sh ONCE on the final integration commit. These manifests are removed with their worktrees at /apex-merge cleanup, so they are gone before deploy runs. minor > patch; major is user-set only. Optional - absent on empty-diff sessions where step 12 emitted no commit.
